description: Classification of the 70 LongMemEval_S (cleaned) knowledge-update questions that have an older and a newer evidence turn. Made by an AI model on 2026-10-30 after reading each question, its answer and both evidence turns. Please review before relying on it. Categories: current = asks for the latest value of something that changed (newer turn holds the answer); previous = asks for the earlier value (older turn holds the answer); both = the answer needs both versions; latest_event = two separate events that both remain true, and the question asks for the most recent; context = the older turn holds no older value of the asked fact; exclude = data problem.
